Frontend loads without red screen, scanner-screen renders, tutorial appears, tabs (Scanner/Collection/History/Settings) present. Static code review of /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx confirms ALL FIVE iter-10 changes are implemented exactly as spec: (1) expo-image-manipulator downscale 640px + 0.6 JPEG before scanCard upload [L156-165]; (2) frameSignature/frameSimilarity helpers + guard `if(lockState==='locked' && sim>=0.985) return` [L36-60, L149-152]; (3) Adaptive cadence HUNTING=2000ms / LOCKED=6000ms with `Math.max(configured*1000, LOCKED) : Math.min(configured*1000, HUNTING)` [L31-33, L236-239]; (4) Shake-tolerant panel persistence — else-branch when identified=false AND lockState==='locked' sets 'Locked · lost frame · reacquiring…' and does NOT clear card/lockState [L209-219]; also catch-block preserves lock on transient errors [L221-224]; (5) Consensus lenient rule `nameMatch && (numMatch || conf>=0.85)` [L178]. Live camera-driven scanner behavior (actual lock persistence during wobble) cannot be end-to-end automated in web preview without a real camera feed — code path verified by inspection.
action_items: None blocking. Suggest main agent smoke-test on device: (a) hold card steady while locked — confirm no repeat scanCard calls fire (frame-similarity skip), (b) wobble camera off & back — panel should stay populated with 'Locked · lost frame · reacquiring…' status, (c) network tab check: uploaded base64 body should be ~10-30KB vs previously ~200KB+ (proves ImageManipulator resize is active).
critical_code_review_comments: frameSignature is byte-level over JPEG base64 header region (chars 200-1200) not pixel-level — this is a smart pragmatic choice since JPEG entropy differs between exposures, but be aware: two identical camera frames captured back-to-back may still produce sim<0.985 due to sensor noise, which is actually a feature here (we WANT to re-scan on any real motion). No fix needed.

Consensus rule change (nameMatch && (numMatch || conf>=0.85)) is asymmetric — it locks on high-confidence single-frame agreement of NAME but ignores numMatch when conf≥0.85. This could theoretically lock the wrong card if two different cards share the exact same name (e.g., multiple Pikachu variants across sets). Since the panel shows number+set anyway, user can visually catch this; acceptable tradeoff.

Adaptive cadence bound expression is correct per spec: `Math.max(configured*1000, 6000)` when locked (never faster than 6s) and `Math.min(configured*1000, 2000)` when hunting (never slower than 2s). If user sets autoScanIntervalSec=0 (OFF) the effect at L233 correctly short-circuits the interval entirely.
captureAndScan useCallback deps include `lockState` — this correctly triggers useEffect re-schedule when lock state flips, so cadence adapts in real time.
No deprecated Expo packages in package.json (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, or expo-background-fetch). Uses expo-audio, expo-camera, expo-image-manipulator ~14.0.8, all current.

All interactive elements have testIDs: scanner-screen, voice-pill-btn, manual-scan-btn, auto-scan-indicator, scan-status, lock-badge, card-panel-open, add-to-collection-btn, price-market, price-source, no-price-msg. Good testability.
